name: MIDA Macro-Tool

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Smoothbore
perks.desc: Smooth shotgun barrel. Greatly increases range at the cost of more projectile spread.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Barrel Shroud
perks.desc:
Balanced shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Grave Robber
perks.desc: Melee final blows or dealing damage with a charged melee reloads this weapon's magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.desc: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Trench Barrel
perks.desc: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for burst damage against Banes, Elites Champions and Minibosses and bulkier minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. MIDA Macro-Tool is a precision frame underneath, providing ×0.8 horizontal recoil, but is officially a MIDA Synergy frame, which when paired with MIDA Multi-Tool boosts sprint speed by ×1.1 and progress the MIDA Software Trait with kills. The stats are decent by comparison with its peers, and are helped at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2699423382 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From the @Mossy-Max spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/ base Magazine size is 5 (max 7) and total ammo is 19. Looking at One-Two Punch as the damage perk, using Full Choke as the barrel perk reduces pellet spread a little, or look for one that helps with Handling. For the magazine perk, Assault Mag ups the fire rate by 5RPM or boost magazine size. To pair with One-Two Punch in the second column to rovides +150% melee damage for 3s for hitting all 12 pellets (10 when enhanced), you'll need a first column perk to improve or bypass reloads. Slideshot is probably top of the tree, refilling 15% of the mag (that's 1 shot at base or 2 when the mag is maxed out at 7) and boosting range and stability by +20 each (+22 when enhanced) when you slide, or Grave Robber refills your magazine on an elemental melee hit or any melee kill. Alternatively, Envious Assassin overflows the magazine to up to ×3 capacity at 10% of mag size per kill with primary weapons and 20% with heavy (12.5%/22.5% enhanced) before readying. Finally, Threat Detector which, when you're within 15m of 1/2+ enemies, adds +15/40 Stability (+19/44 enhanced), +18/60 Reload Speed (+22/64 enhanced) with a ×0.9/0.81 animation scalar and +25/100 (+29/100 enhanced) Handling. For the Origin Trait, Roar of Battle grants +10 Stability and Handling for 6s, after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
